name: web-orlina-mens-catalogue-and-product-checkout-flow
title: Orlina men's catalogue, product page and cart drawer flow with a quote banner
whatItIs: A dark page with a quote banner 'Own your presence. Elevated essentials crafted for the modern man.' above a men's catalogue grid, a product detail page (Relaxed Fit Cotton Overshirt, size and colour options, similar products) and a small cart drawer overlay showing item, quantity and checkout total, linked by lines.
whatItMeans: Complete and premium; the quote frames a purely functional shopping flow in brand voice.
techniques: Open a functional flow with a branded quote.
Overlay a cart drawer as a small floating panel.
Show size and colour pickers explicitly.

vocabulary.definition: A slide-out panel showing the current cart.
A short branded statement used as a section intro.
